BiblicalUsage: Dawn is the hour Darius rises to run to the lions' den. The king arises very early in the morning — at the first light — and goes in haste to see whether Daniel's God has delivered him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe dawn is the hour of the king's hope: Darius could not wait for full light before he ran to the den.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
